mapper.delete: DELETE FROM FOLLOW WHERE FOLLOWER_EMAIL = #{followerEmail} AND FARMER_EMAIL = #{farmerEmail}
mapper.select: SELECT F.FARMER_EMAIL AS farmerEmail ,M.MEM_NICKNAME AS farmerNickname FROM FOLLOW F JOIN MEM_INFO M ON F.FARMER_EMAIL = M.MEM_EMAIL WHERE F.FOLLOWER_EMAIL = #{followerEmail}

SELECT F.FOLLOWER_EMAIL AS followerEmail, F.FARMER_EMAIL AS farmerEmail, M.MEM_NICKNAME AS followerNickname FROM FOLLOW F JOIN MEM_INFO M ON F.FOLLOWER_EMAIL = M.MEM_EMAIL WHERE F.FARMER_EMAIL = #{farmerEmail}
